gripOrHq.title: Corporate Boon
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put four Boon counters on Corporate Boon when you score it.
Boon counter: Gain an action. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.

gripOrHq.title: Fatal Attractor
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: New Blood
gripOrHq.rulesText: Conceal all revealed but unrezzed ice; then rearrange your installed ice by swapping pairs of ice while Runner looks away.

gripOrHq.title: Mastiff
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Do 1 brain damage. *Do 1 Net damage. *For the remainder of the run, all ice is encountered at +1 strength. *Trace 5-If trace is successful, give Runner a Mastiff counter. Each Mastiff counter does 1 brain damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Mastiff counter by taking an action to spend [4]. *End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Data Darts
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 3 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

heapOrArchives.title: Virus Test Site
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may advance Virus Test Site before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Test Site, it does 2 Net damage per advancement counter on it, or 1 Net damage if it has no counters, even if it is not installed or rezzed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Test Site is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

discardCards.title: Krash
discardCards.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Private LDL Access
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

ice.title: Neural Blade
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

ice.title: Fragmentation Storm
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 4 - If trace is successful, end the run and trash a program, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [1].

ice.title: Data Naga
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Virus Test Site
root.rulesText: You may advance Virus Test Site before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Test Site, it does 2 Net damage per advancement counter on it, or 1 Net damage if it has no counters, even if it is not installed or rezzed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Test Site is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: TRAP!
root.rulesText: If you pay [4] when Runner accesses TRAP!, it does 3 Net damage and gives Runner a tag, even if TRAP! is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If TRAP! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.
